data.name: fix_naive_aware_datetime_bugs
data.description: Diagnose and fix test failures caused by mixing naive and aware datetimes.
data.content:
1. Re-run the failing test and capture the traceback.
2. Find where a naive datetime meets an aware one.
3. Normalise both sides to UTC at the parsing boundary.
4. Add a regression test with an aware timestamp.
5. Re-run the whole suite before committing.

update_note: Added a skill for naive / aware datetime bugs.
